title: Evaluate a signed matrix-product fiber from three acquired ranks
statement: For X in Fq^(p by d), Y in Fq^(d by r), XY=Z and character D, the signed fiber is an explicit Gaussian double sum depending only on rank Z,rank D and rank(ZD). Reverse Hom pairing is acquired from a nonzero commutator-annihilating binary functional.

requires: Actual simple matrix nucleus and nondegenerate reverse Hom pairing
provides: Polynomial exact signed universal-product evaluator without a field/matrix/subspace enumeration oracle
assumptions: Represented binary matrix trace can vanish at even multiplicity; it is not the required functional
Binary affine slice need not be Fq-linear
